text_block_list.text:
Agnes Tachyon, having run the Nippon Derby 
with an imposing, dignified stride.

Only the Kikuka Sho remained to complete 
the Triple Crown run. However, Agnes 
Tachyon told him not to get his hopes up 
and simply left for home.

With lingering uncertainty over whether 
her whimsical self would truly run in the 
Kikuka Sho, the days leading up to their 
next objective were about to begin.
